source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 1958426 JavaScript follow-up supplies a caller label to acquireSemaphore and releaseSemaphore after the native interface gained that argument. The local-mbox repair uses the same folder and label at both calls. The IMAP tests use MailServices.accounts as the same opaque holder at acquire and release, with a test-code label. The label explains the caller; it does not establish ownership or thread safety. Fixed fetch assertions distinguish a header fetched while locked from an offline body stored after release. No test ran here.
title: Keep JavaScript folder-lock calls aligned with diagnostic arguments
